# Khem Raj Pradhan

> Independent life companion, systems researcher, and regenerative living guide based in Damak, Nepal. Founder of the Hunate Movement and co founder of the Mery and Khem life design studio.

## Pages
- [Home](https://khemrajpradhan.com.np/): overview of the three connected worlds, plus the full life journey told in order through photos and short stories.
- [Hire Khem](https://khemrajpradhan.com.np/hire/): hire Khem as a life companion, advisor, and designer. Services, process, ethics, and booking.
- [Hunate Movement](https://khemrajpradhan.com.np/hunate/): a citizen led movement for balance among Humanity, Nature, and Technology.
- [Mery and Khem Studio](https://khemrajpradhan.com.np/studio/): a brand, digital, and life design studio. Services across ten categories.
